newsitem.title: USA: Clinton opposes budget amendment -- White House.
newsitem.headline: Clinton opposes budget amendment -- White House.

text.p: The White House Thursday said President Clinton opposes amending the U.S. Constitution to require a balanced federal budget, calling it "a bad idea."

Seeking to clarify comments earlier in the week by Clinton that indicated he was softening his opposition, White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters "he has not changed" his position. "He's against it."
"He's opposed to it," McCurry said of a balanced budget amendment. "He thinks its a bad idea."
The Republicans have said they intend to push for the amendment once the new Congress is sworn in this January.
Earlier this week, during an exchange with reporters, Clinton appeared to soften his opposition to the amendment.
McCurry said Clinton would "speak against it," even though the president has no direct role in constitutional amendments, which are sent to the states for ratification.
